tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Store a new memory in SKMemory (polaroid snapshot).

source.description: Where this memory came from (default: mcp).

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Full-text search across all SKMemory layers with optional metadata filters.

tags.description: Filter results to memories matching ALL specified tags.

layer.description: Filter results to a specific memory layer.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 instant. Only memories valid then: valid_from (or created_at) <= as_of and valid_to unset or > as_of. Omit for no temporal filter (closed facts are still returned).

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Only returns memories that audience may see. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

detail.description: 'full' (default) returns whole memories. 'index' returns one cheap row per hit (id, title, date, rank score, short snippet, source_ref, est_tokens vs est_tokens_full); follow with memory_recall for the full memory or memory_expand for the raw episode.

tools.name: memory_expand
tools.description: Return the raw episode (session JSONL slice) a digest memory was made from, when its source_ref resolves to a file under this agent's sessions directory. Capped in size. Owner sessions only: raw episodes carry no audience labels.

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_check_duplicate
tools.description: Advisory pre-write duplicate check: semantically search for existing memories similar to a piece of candidate content, BEFORE storing it. Read-only — does not write, merge, or modify anything. Complements memory_store's automatic exact-hash dedup by catching near-duplicates (paraphrases, reworded notes) via embedding similarity.

content.description: Candidate content to check for near-duplicates.

threshold.description: Minimum similarity 0.0-1.0 to count as a match (default: 0.73, tuned for mxbai-embed-large).

k.description: Max candidates to consider before threshold filtering (default: 5).

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Recall a specific memory by its ID.

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_history
tools.description: Supersession chain through a memory, oldest first: what it replaced and what replaced it, with each record's validity window.

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List memories with optional layer and tag filters.

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete (forget) a memory by its ID.

tools.name: memory_promote
tools.description: Promote a memory to a higher persistence tier (short→mid→long).

memory_id.description: ID of the memory to promote.

summary.description: Optional compressed summary for the promoted memory.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: Compress a session's short-term memories into one mid-term memory.

tools.name: memory_context
tools.description: Load token-efficient memory context for agent system prompt injection. Uses tiered lazy loading: today's memories (full), yesterday (summaries), older (reference counts only). Deep details available via memory_search.

token_budget.description: Max tokens for context (default: 4000). Uses word_count * 1.3 approximation.

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_export
tools.description: Export all memories to a dated JSON backup file.

tools.name: memory_import
tools.description: Restore memories from a JSON backup file.

backup_path.description: Absolute path to the backup JSON file.

tools.name: memory_health
tools.description: Full health check across all backends (primary, vector, graph).

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_graph
tools.description: Graph operations: traverse connections, get lineage, find clusters, and pivot through entities or citations to related claims. Requires the AGE graph backend.

query.description: Entity or citation text for related_claims.

reader.description: Audience the results are for, e.g. '@public', '@community', '@work-circle', '@inner-circle', '@work:<x>' or 'channel:<id>'. Omit for the owner. Can only narrow a SKMEMORY_READER declared for the server process.

tools.name: memory_synthesize_daily
tools.description: Synthesize today's (or a given date's) memories into a single narrative entry stored in mid-term. No LLM — uses tag frequency, emotional arc, and template-based narrative.

date.description: Date to synthesize (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: memory_synthesize_dreams
tools.description: Process dream-engine memories into curated narrative memories grouped by theme. Creates one mid-term memory per theme cluster.

since.description: Only process dreams after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 7 days ago.

tools.name: memory_auto_context
tools.description: Search all memory layers for context related to keywords. Runs one search per keyword (max 10), deduplicates, and ranks by fused search relevance (reciprocal-rank sum across keywords); emotional intensity is only a tiebreak. Returns results within a token budget. Background tool: it does not count as a read, so it never reinforces memories. Use this for contextual auto-search.

reader.description: Audience the results are for (see memory_search). Omit for the owner.

tools.name: memory_verify
tools.description: Verify integrity hashes for all stored memories. Returns a report of passed, tampered, and unsealed memories. Tampered memories are flagged with CRITICAL severity.

tools.name: memory_audit
tools.description: Show the most recent audit trail entries. The audit trail is a chain-hashed JSONL log of every store/recall/delete/tamper operation.

last.description: Number of recent entries to return (default: 20).

tools.name: memory_extract
tools.description: Extract decisions, preferences, milestones, problems, and emotional moments from arbitrary text using regex pattern matching. Returns the matches without storing anything — useful for previewing what auto-save would capture.

text.description: Text to extract memory-worthy moments from.

tools.name: memory_save_session
tools.description: Auto-extract memories from a conversation transcript and store each as a short-term memory. Mirrors the Stop hook used by Claude Code's settings.json but invoked directly via MCP. Returns counts + the IDs of saved memories.

session_id.description: Session identifier (default: auto from CLAUDE_SESSION_ID env or 'mcp-session').

min_length.description: Minimum extracted-segment length (default: 100 — same as the Stop hook).

event_at.description: ISO 8601 time the conversation happened. When given, relative dates (yesterday, next Monday) in each saved memory get the resolved ISO date appended, in this timestamp's own offset, and the memory's event_at is set. Absent: text is saved unchanged.

tools.name: memory_pre_compact
tools.description: Emergency snapshot of current conversation context before context compression. Stores the last N characters as a single short-term memory tagged 'pre-compact'. Mirrors the PreCompact hook used by Claude Code.

tail_chars.description: How many trailing characters to save (default: 4000).

tools.name: memory_remind
tools.description: Create a time intention: remember to do something at a later time. It is delivered through sk-alert by the intentions tick. Owner only.

due_at.description: ISO 8601 time, or 'in N days' / 'in N hours'.

interval_s.description: Repeat every N seconds (re-arms after each fire).

tools.name: memory_intentions
tools.description: List intentions, optionally by state (pending, armed, fired, done...). Owner only.

tools.name: memory_intention_done
tools.description: Mark an intention done. Owner only.

memory_expand.note: hidden id is not-found; a declared reader is then refused, raw episodes are unlabeled

memory_history.note: chain cut at the first hidden member; hidden start is not-found

memory_store.note: dedup only matches memories the reader can see

memory_save_session.note: dedup only matches memories the reader can see

memory_pre_compact.note: dedup only matches memories the reader can see

memory_promote.note: a write: a declared reader, per-call or env, is refused

memory_forget.note: a delete: a declared reader, per-call or env, is refused

memory_remind.note: creates standing intentions that fire into hooks and alerts

memory_intentions.note: intention titles are unclassified private text

memory_extract.note: pure text-in, text-out; reads no stored memory
